about_the_game:
Beatdown City Survivors is an immersive sandbox bullet heaven beat-em-up that knocks the genre on its head. The city is a nightmarish playground filled with gas to ignite, puddles to electrify, and cars to blow up--and you'll need to manipulate every element possible to wipe out the gruesome zombies, mutants and blood- thirsty creatures lurking in the streets.

  • Bullet heaven beat-em-up action! This dual stick Survivors-like feels tight like a beat 'em up, meaning enemies need to attack to hurt you, and you'll use hand-to-hand combat, chairs, pipes all sorts of weapons on swarms of enemies to bash your way to safety.

  • Make wild weapon combos! Strap knives to a slipper to shred hundreds of monstrous fiends or combine a pipe and fireworks to make a bazooka, allowing you to ignite cars and blow up everything in sight.

  • Recruit and play as new survivors! Build your army with an eclectic group of fighters who all have their own attacks and specials. Survivors can be anything from martial arts masters, to socialites, to a Shiba Inu in some high tops.

  • Upgrade and Conquer! Unlock >100 weapons and passives to create the ultimate build! Cash and tokens buy upgrades that improve your stats and increase your chance of survival. 

  • The City is Yours! Play through levels including the desolate streets of Times Square, a zoo filled with mutated animals, and a subway filled with giant horrors to become the ultimate face-slamming survivor.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 (64 bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-3210
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: DirectX 10 capable GPU
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system

short_description: Beatdown City Survivors is a monster bashing immersive sandbox time bullet heaven game. Upgrade oddball weapons like pigeons, boots, & fireworks. Combine them to create hilarious game breaking strategies. Kick, ignite, recruit survivors, craft combo weapons, freeze, crush, electrify--and survive!

English*, French, German, Portuguese - Brazil, Simplified Chinese, Spanish - Latin America
*languages with full audio support
